# Review Starter Kits

Review Starter Kits are reusable workflow templates for PRISMA Workbench projects. They help teams start with consistent screening criteria, database export notes, dual-review handoff steps, and audit appendix language.

The kits are static-first and local-first. They do not add a backend, paid lock, account system, license check, default cloud upload, or database crawler.

## Available templates

- Screening criteria: `docs/templates/screening-criteria/README.md`
- Database export: `docs/templates/database-export/README.md`
- Dual-review SOP: `docs/templates/dual-review-sop.md`
- Audit appendix: `docs/templates/audit-appendix-template.md`

## Intended use

- Copy the relevant template into a review protocol, team SOP, or appendix draft.
- Keep project-specific decisions editable and auditable.
- Treat templates as starting points, not automatic methodological decisions.
